title: Against Celsus
author: origen
attributionNote: The attribution is recorded as the edition and the scholarly consensus give it; where the attribution is disputed, the work says so.
description: Origen's reply to Celsus's second-century attack on Christianity, 'The True Word'. Because Origen quotes Celsus extensively, the work preserves the argument of a pagan critic who would otherwise be lost.
historicalContext: Written late in Origen's life, during the persecution under Decius, at the request of his patron Ambrose.
availabilityNote: Streamed from the Christian Classics Ethereal Library at read time. Crombie's translation from the Ante-Nicene Fathers, served by the CCEL.
